sets.tip: بعد از What / Where / When / Why / How معمولاً do/does یا is/are می‌آید و بعد فاعل: Where + do + you + live?

items.en: Where do you live?
What time does the shop open?
Why are you late today?
Who is your English teacher?
How do you go to work?
When does the class start?
What kind of music do you like?
Which bus goes to the museum?

sets.tip: برای سؤال بله/خیر در زمان حال: Do (I, you, we, they) یا Does (he, she, it) + فاعل + فعل ساده. بعد از does فعل s نمی‌گیرد.

items.en: Do you have a larger size?
Does this bus stop at the airport?
items.fa: این اتوبوس در فرودگاه توقف می‌کند؟

items.en: Do you work on weekends?
Does she speak English at work?
items.fa: او سر کار انگلیسی صحبت می‌کند؟

items.en: Do they live near the park?
Does the hotel have free wifi?
Do you take this medicine every day?
items.fa: این دارو را هر روز مصرف می‌کنی؟

items.en: Does your brother like football?

sets.tip: با فعل to be، فعل می‌آید اول جمله: Is / Are / Was / Were + فاعل ...؟

items.en: Is the bank near here?
Are you ready to order?
Is breakfast included in the price?
Are there any shops on this street?
Was the weather good last weekend?
items.fa: آخر هفته‌ی پیش هوا خوب بود؟

items.en: Were you at home yesterday evening?
Is this seat free?
Are they your neighbors?

sets.tip: برای درخواست مؤدبانه: Can I ...؟ Could you ...؟ Would you like ...؟ فعل بعدی ساده است.

items.en: Can I pay by card?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
Can you help me with this form?
items.fa: می‌توانید در پر کردن این فرم کمکم کنید؟

items.en: Could I have the bill, please?
items.fa: لطفاً می‌توانم صورتحساب را داشته باشم؟

items.en: Would you like some more water?
Can we sit by the window?
Could you repeat that, please?
Can I try this jacket on?
items.fa: می‌توانم این کت را امتحان کنم؟

sets.en: How much / How many / How long
sets.tip: How much برای چیزهای نشمردنی و قیمت، How many برای چیزهای شمردنی، How long برای مدت، How often برای تکرار.

items.en: How much is this jacket?
How many people are in your family?
How long does the trip take?
How often do you go to the gym?
items.fa: هر چند وقت به باشگاه می‌روی؟

items.en: How old is your sister?
How far is the station from here?
items.fa: ایستگاه از اینجا چقدر دور است؟

items.en: How much does a ticket cost?
How many rooms does the flat have?

sets.tip: در گذشته‌ی ساده: Did + فاعل + فعل ساده. بعد از did فعل به شکل ساده می‌ماند (go نه went).

items.en: Did you sleep well last night?
What did you do yesterday?
Where did you go on holiday?
Did you call the taxi company?
When did you start this job?
items.fa: کی این کار را شروع کردی؟

items.en: Who did you meet at the party?
items.fa: در مهمانی با چه کسی آشنا شدی؟

items.en: Did she buy a new coat?
What did you eat for lunch?

sets.tip: برای آینده: Are you going to ...؟ یا Will you ...؟ هر دو با فعل ساده ادامه پیدا می‌کنند.

items.en: What are you going to do tomorrow?
Are you going to take a class?
Will it rain this afternoon?
Where will you stay in Paris?
Is she going to move to a new house?
items.fa: او قرار است به خانه‌ی جدیدی نقل مکان کند؟

items.en: What time will the meeting finish?
Are they going to come to the party?
Will you call me tonight?

sets.tip: سؤال‌های پرکاربرد در خرید و رستوران را با همین الگوها بساز.

items.en: Is the sale only today?
Do you have this in blue?
items.fa: این را به رنگ آبی دارید؟

items.en: Where is the fitting room?
Is the tip included?
What do you recommend?
Can I have the receipt?
Is this dish vegetarian?
Could we have some more bread?
items.fa: می‌توانیم کمی نان بیشتر داشته باشیم؟

sets.tip: سؤال‌هایی که در سفر، ایستگاه و هتل زیاد لازم می‌شوند.

items.en: How do I get to the station?
Is it far from here?
Which platform does the train leave from?
items.fa: قطار از کدام سکو حرکت می‌کند؟

items.en: What time is check out?
Do you have a room for two nights?
Can I leave my suitcase here?
Where can I buy a ticket?
Is there a pharmacy near here?

sets.tip: سؤال درباره‌ی ساعت، تاریخ و برنامه با What time / When / Is ... OK?

items.en: What time is it?
What is the date today?
When is your birthday?
What time do you get up?
items.fa: چه ساعتی از خواب بلند می‌شوی؟

items.en: Do you have time for a coffee?
What day is the meeting?
Is Thursday at ten OK for you?
items.fa: پنجشنبه ساعت ده برایت خوب است؟

items.en: When does the next train leave?
